# C03 — Determination

## #0

Determination is the act through which a field becomes **this**: something can be distinguished, addressed, compared, remembered or acted upon. A distinction makes its terms available together, in a relation that lets one count as this and another as its alternative. It gives difference actual consequence.

A [faithful definition](../A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) must say something definite, and its defining act belongs to what it attempts to account for. The defining act makes a distinction available for further use and return. Its result is positive; a mark need not falsify what it discloses merely because the mark is finite.

## #1

The first distinction has two faces. It identifies something and makes the difference by which it can be identified. Saying “this” selects from a field while holding enough continuity for the selected instance to be recognised again. The [copula](../A02-Copula-Self-Identity-through-Difference.md) relates a name to this instance in this circumstance, preserving identity through their difference. Repeating a name does not itself count its different bearers. Determination includes the individuation by which a name can reach anyone or anything at all.

The marked/unmarked distinction in [[symbolon/episteme/sources/mathematics-logic/spencer-brown/spencer-brown-1969-laws-form/spencer-brown-1969-laws-form|Spencer-Brown's Laws of Form]] makes a contrast available within the calculus of indications. The unmarked state belongs to that calculus's rules. The subject-condition concerns the act for which a marked distinction becomes available. Their comparison must retain those different operations; exact opening and re-entry passages have not yet been located in the selected 1969 edition.

## #2

To determine positively is also to exclude. What falls outside the selected term helps give it a boundary, even when the account does not name what it has excluded. “Not selected” cannot therefore mean “irrelevant to how the selection was made.”

[Apoha](C18-Apoha.md) makes the excluded alternatives consequential to a term’s meaning. [Vikalpa–Saṃkalpa](C17-Vikalpa-Samkalpa.md) differentiates alternatives and gathers them into formative commitment. Negation denies; distinction lets terms differ; selection makes an alternative operative. Treating all three as rejection loses the positive world-making that the cut accomplishes.

The `−/+` determination gives this work force. Withdrawal and extension remain co-present directions of a differentiating movement. A cut can become effective without its poles becoming independent substances.

## #3

A determination can recur as **another one of those**. In `X/x`, determining capacity becomes legible through a local instance, while the instance remains available to recurrence, comparison and change. The same letter in different cases keeps capacity and instance related. A recurring dream, rhythm or thought can disclose determining capacity through another particular occurrence; the occurrence changes while the capacity remains available for further differentiation.

Taylor’s [[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy|core derivation]] traces the sequence: parent `/ = −/−`; conscious circumstance `0/1`; question/assertion `?/!`; force `−/+`; recurrence `X/x`; personed context `AM/IS`; differential horizon `∞/dx`; return `1/0`. The [complete order and its inversions](../A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) relate the achieved determination to the activity through which it becomes available. These are distinct joints of determining activity, not interchangeable glosses for a mark.

Measurement makes a further commitment: a unit, comparison or ratio renders a difference reckonable. A [ratio](../A15-Ratio-Rationality-Measure-Reckoning-Harmony-Account.md) compares determinate quantities through their stated relation. Precision belongs to the stated relation; it cannot promote a chosen measure into the source of everything it measures.

## #4

In `AM/IS`, what can be predicated meets the one for whom it matters through a relation of address. Body, memory, task, inherited language and concern participate in what becomes this object or this decision. [Context](C08-Context-Context-Frame.md) makes that address effective within its horizon; [operative measure](C14-Maya-Operative-Measure.md) apportions what the situated actor can do, know, desire, time and order.

An account of a selection becomes another selection. The [achieved form cannot absorb the act now accounting for it](C04-Formal-Limit.md): this further selection reproduces the determining relation. The successful distinction remains; its determining condition has not become its possession.

## #5→0

[Referential exclusion](../../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/language-symbol-dialogue/DEVELOPMENT-language-symbol-dialogue.md#language-exclusion) makes absent alternatives consequential to a term's meaning. A finite figure gives a distinction visible form. The act of determining selects, relates and makes that result available for further inquiry. Each contributes its particular work to the achieved determination.

The [zero-reception history](../../../symbolon/episteme/dossiers/zero-reception.md#2--a-reception-story-also-requires-a-source) shows how a source correction changes a subsequent assertion. Nothaft’s consulted official abstract challenges the familiar satanic-zero and ban narrative. That abstract supplies the direction of the article's argument, not the evidence for an individual medieval case. The next historical assertion must therefore change its warrant and scope while the distinct mathematical operations remain available. A claim stays determinate by naming what its available evidence can test.

A completed determination enters the inherited field of the next act. Return makes its source, criterion, exclusions and consequences available again. For [operational parity](C45-Operational-Parity.md), making the distinction explicit must change some actual operation if it is to claim operational efficacy. A label alone has not performed that return.

Within a [[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD|region of encounter]], name and count render a participant discriminable; account becomes answerable when the region and participant can return to alter it. A [faithful definition](C02-Faithful-Definition.md) remains definite enough to use and related enough to answer for its use.
